title: Emergency Preparedness Longest Quiet Streak
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radio:test
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day last(events) as prev_events
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where isnotnull(prev_day) AND prev_events>0 AND events=0 AND gap_days>=2
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_quiet_streak_days
description: Finds the longest multi-day gap with zero emergency preparedness events after activity was previously present.
value: Quiet streaks often mean a broken export, a forgotten subscription, or a habit that silently died — all worth catching early.
implementation: Run daily on `radio:test` after ingestion; investigate streaks that exceed your normal pause window for this domain.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest quiet streak with supporting timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the longest stretch with no emergency preparedness activity at all so you can tell when a feed or habit went quiet for too long.
